note: In-game hero rig (`UnitMC`, symbol 1970). `timeline` holds the top-level placements per SWF frame; `groups` holds packed part atlases keyed by frame. Each frame's `r` is [page, x, y, w, h, anchorX, anchorY] in sheet pixels, trimmed to the art. Limb/head frames carry the nested `skin`/`gun`/`face`/`hair` placements `Stats_Classes.setSkin` recolours. Sheet pixels are `scale` times the clip-local unit; divide the rig matrix by `scale` to place them.
